### `get_chat_view_comments`

**Get Chat View Comments** · `GET /api/v2/view/{view_id}/comment` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View comments from a Chat view.

If you do not include the `start` and `start_id` parameters, this endpoint will return the most recent 25 comments.

Use the `start` and `start id` parameters of the oldest comment to retrieve the next 25 comments.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `view_id` | path | string | yes | 105 (string) |
| `start` | query | integer |  | Enter the `date` of a Chat view comment using Unix time in milliseconds. |
| `start_id` | query | string |  | Enter the Comment `id` of a Chat view comment. |

### `get_post_subtype_ids`

**Get Post Subtype IDs** · `GET /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/comments/types/{comment_type}/subtypes` · API v3 · 🟢 read-only

Get the ID of each post subtype (Announcement, Discussion, Idea, and Update) for your Workspace, to use when [sending a message](https://developer.clickup.com/reference/createchatmessage) with `type: post`.

Subtype IDs are unique to each Workspace.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | integer | yes | ID of the logged-in user's Workspace. |
| `comment_type` | path | `"post"` \| `"ai"` \| `"syncup"` \| `"ai_via_brain"` | yes |  |

### `get_task_comments`

**Get Task Comments** · `GET /api/v2/task/{task_id}/comment` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View task comments.

Retrieve comments from a task. Results are returned in reverse chronological order (newest to oldest). By default, the request returns the 25 most recent comments.

[Pagination](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/task-comments-pagination): To fetch the next page of history (older comments), you must use the `start` and `start_id` parameters together, using the data from the last comment of the current response.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes |  |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by it's custom task id, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |
| `start` | query | integer |  | The Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) of the reference comment. Required for pagination. Must be used in combination with `start_id`. Value should be the `date` of the last comment from the previous response. |
| `start_id` | query | string |  | The unique ID of the reference comment. Required for pagination. Must be used in combination with `start`. Value should be the `id` of the last comment from the previous response. |
